concept: A grand ornate diplomatic table laden with empty chairs, crystal glasses knocked over, papers scattered and torn, a red carpet that transitions from vibrant crimson to frayed and blackened threads. Golden candelabras tilted precariously. A single microphone standing alone on the platform, its cord severed. Storm clouds visible through tall windows. Rendered in bold, high-contrast shapes with dramatic shadows, modernist style, emphasizing fracture and division.
explanation: Today's headlines paint a portrait of fractured global order: diplomatic meetings yielding minimal progress, walkouts and exclusions from high-level gatherings, escalating violence across multiple regions, and deepening ideological and national divisions. The table—traditionally a symbol of negotiation and shared humanity—becomes a stage for conflict, exclusion, and abandonment. Even moments of unity (the Pope's Mass) are dwarfed by the dominant theme of breakdown and refusal to engage.

headlines.title: Xi got Trump's red carpet welcome - but not everything he wanted
headlines.summary: China wanted progress on trade, technology and Taiwan - but hasn't got as much as it would have hoped for.

headlines.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
headlines.summary: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

headlines.title: Media outlets banned by Trump denied access to White House dinner despite judge's order
headlines.summary: CNN and MS NOW reporters say they were barred from covering a state dinner after a judge ruled their passes should be restored.

headlines.title: Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit
headlines.summary: The highpoint of his time in Paris will be a giant Mass attended by more than half a million people.

headlines.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
headlines.summary: Australia, which has strict social media restrictions and has proposed controls on algorithms and smart glasses, announced the breach at the UN.

headlines.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
headlines.summary: Pakistan says it struck 10 targets, adding the strikes were "strictly limited to identified military objectives".

headlines.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
headlines.summary: A male suspect from Ukraine was arrested after the stabbings in the town of Jarosław, police say.

headlines.title: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described the measures as "common-sense tools that do not divide but really help to integrate".

headlines.title: Rapper Macklemore announces 'Free Palestine' tour after Ed Sheeran fallout
headlines.summary: Proceeds from the tour, which begins in Dublin next month, will go to organisations supporting Palestinians, he says.

headlines.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
headlines.summary: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.

headlines.title: 105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
headlines.summary: The suspect is alleged to have been an accessory to murder at the Stalag 326 camp, where tens of thousands of Soviet PoWs died.

headlines.title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
headlines.summary: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.
